gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-poppins: Poppins draws round, rope-loose curves with no thick-thin flicker. Give it a modest size and let Baloo Bhaina 2 carry the bold, wide-terminalled display voice above without competition.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-roboto-slab: Chunky and cheerful, with s terminals that flare wide. Roboto Slab follows in a structured slab-serif, its middle zone dominating each line, and Baloo Bhaina 2 earns its place when big and short.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-rubik: Rubik is soft and sans, with lowercase letters that look big beside the capitals. And Baloo Bhaina 2 above it brings the bold, distinctive punch, while the body's round shapes stay clear paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-bitter: Baloo Chettan 2 looks magnified even when it isn't, with wide channels running into every counter. Bitter then settles in as a grounded slab-serif, its big lowercase and see-through s making a long passage feel steady.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-inter: Inter has counters that breathe like a cut reed, and a smooth, tube-like line. And Baloo Chettan 2 earns its keep big and short, where its expressive shapes get room to speak.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-mulish: Fat, friendly, almost magnified lettering up top. Mulish takes over below in sans-serif with horseshoe-open apertures and no thick-thin modulation, so a slightly larger body size would suit it nicely.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-poppins: Baloo Chettan 2 looks magnified, with wide channels leading into each counter. Poppins, a modern sans-serif with rope-loose curves and no thick-thin modulation, is the quiet, sturdy partner that lets that expressive heading stand out.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-rubik: Those wide channels leading into every counter make Baloo Chettan 2 look blown up at any size. Rubik is the soft, readable one.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-bitter: Lowercase that stands almost cap-tall gives Baloo Da 2 its commanding look. Bitter then reads in a grounded slab-serif, with a big lowercase eye and see-through s, so a long passage feels dependable.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-instrument-sans: Tall, bold and a bit brash. Baloo Da 2 shouts with wide-set terminals while Instrument Sans answers in a plain sans, its c ends pointing apart like pincers and its strokes cut at one width.
